title: Rational design of hydrophobic deep eutectic solvents tunes the catalytic pocket of lipase for the sustainable synthesis of structural lipids.
authors: Han, Yiran; Chen, Zhiheng; Fang, Hao; Hu, Yi; Nian, Binbin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究疏水深共熔溶剂调控脂肪酶催化口袋构象以促进结构脂合成，虽以酶为对象且涉及蛋白构象计算，但核心是溶剂工程应用，方法创新有限。
abstract: The global epidemic of metabolic diseases has accelerated the demand for functional structured lipids, particularly medium- and long-chain triacylglycerols (MLCTs), which have attracted significant attention due to their dual advantages of rapid energy supply and provision of essential fatty acids. However, the enzymatic synthesis of MLCTs has long been constrained by the solvent-enzyme compatibility paradox, wherein solvents capable of effectively dissolving hydrophobic substrates tend to strip the essential water layer from the enzyme, leading to catalytic failure. Here, we report a strategy with notable improvement potential that overcomes this bottleneck by employing a rationally designed hydrophobic deep eutectic solvent (DESs) system, cyclohexanone and lauric acid at a 2:1 ratio. Systematic screening of 44 solvent systems revealed that this specific DESs enables Candida antarctica Lipase B (Novozym 435) to achieve an outstanding yield of 88.17% +/- 1.42% under optimized conditions (55  degrees C, 24 h), significantly outperforming conventional organic solvents. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations further unveiled its unique microscopic mechanism: the hydrophobic DES not only acts as a reaction medium but also actively modulates the enzyme's catalytic pocket. By stabilizing the open conformation of the lipase lid region (alpha5 and alpha10 helices) and maintaining an optimal pocket volume (V(index) = 1.11), this solvent system significantly enhances the substrate binding free energy to -122.25 kJ/mol, thereby promoting proper substrate anchoring. Moreover, the system demonstrates excellent industrial robustness, retaining over 90% of enzyme activity after five reuse cycles. This study establishes an alternative pathway distinct from mainstream frameworks of solvent-guided enzymatic reaction engineering, where rational design of non-biological media is used to regulate the machinery of biological macromolecules, providing a new theoretical foundation for green biomanufacturing.
abstract_zh: 全球代谢性疾病的流行加速了对功能性结构脂质的需求，特别是中长链甘油三酯（MLCTs），因其兼具快速能量供应和提供必需脂肪酸的双重优势而受到广泛关注。然而，MLCTs的酶法合成长期受制于溶剂-酶相容性悖论，即能有效溶解疏水性底物的溶剂往往剥离酶表面的必需水层，导致催化失效。在此，我们报告了一种具有显著改进潜力的策略，通过采用合理设计的疏水性低共熔溶剂（DESs）体系，即环己酮与月桂酸以2:1比例组合，克服了这一瓶颈。对44种溶剂体系的系统筛选揭示，该特定DESs能使南极假丝酵母脂肪酶B（Novozym 435）在优化条件下（55°C，24小时）实现88.17% ± 1.42%的卓越产率，显著优于传统有机溶剂。分子动力学（MD）模拟进一步揭示了其独特的微观机制：疏水性DES不仅作为反应介质，还主动调节酶的催化口袋。通过稳定脂肪酶盖子区域（α5和α10螺旋）的开放构象并维持最佳口袋体积（V(index) = 1.11），该溶剂体系显著增强了底物结合自由能至-122.25 kJ/mol，从而促进底物的正确锚定。此外，该体系展现出优异的工业稳健性，在五次循环使用后仍保留超过90%的酶活性。本研究建立了一条区别于主流溶剂引导酶反应工程框架的替代路径，其中通过合理设计非生物介质来调控生物大分子的机制，为绿色生物制造提供了新的理论基础。
